basis.text: Interoperability with keripy 1.x, not conformance: the reading the suite's KERI decision procedure (docs/design.md, KERI) gives a KERI 1.0 body with keripy 1.x's field set, where keri-v1.0.1 would grade the same reading SHOULD under the quoted sentence. description: The inception of KS-05 arrives signed by one key, then again signed by another. Together the two copies satisfy the threshold, so a validator that kept the first copy, as line 1266 says it should, accepts the event. The safety half, graded at MUST without keri.escrow, is the companion case KS-06s. Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0005 (KS-06) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: signing threshold completed by a second copy
